changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6169-chatbot-authoring-face-type.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `showTimestamp`, `userAvatarUrl`, `userAvatarFallback`, `assistantAvatarUrl`, `assistantAvatarFallback`, `maxHeight` — display fields. - `autoResponse`, `autoResponseText`, `autoResponseDelay` — the local auto-response (demo/playground) fields, already live via a real consumer (`packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`). - `onSend` — the send-callback, now typed on the published authoring face rather than against the plugin's internal runtime message type. Its `messages` element is the authoring `ChatMessage` widened by the three runtime-only approval states a chat runtime hands back (objectui#10018).

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `5c94589f0` (merge-base with origin/main): 6 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1684 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2284 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36408838331)

## Contract review

Inputs read: card #10926 (body + comments `5866972381` claim, `5868024803` dev report, `5868060731` file-surface supplement), PR #10950 body, file list and the net diff `origin/main...8d4efd6` (merge-base = `origin/main` `5c94589`; 7 files, +710/−39), the 43 check-runs on the head, `docs/adr/0057-console-ai-chat-one-conversation-docked.md` on `origin/main`, and the Amendment A2 text on PR #10947's branch (`4a66540`). Gate verdicts on the head: 43 check-runs completed, 40 `success`, 3 `skipped` (dependabot, Test (coverage), Test (coverage shard)), 0 failed. The Governed Surface Queue Guard is green and the code PR touches no governed path.

### ① Derived judgments

Each behaviour or surface the diff implies, judged against the maintainer ruling 「绑定当前应用（推荐）」 as presented on the card and against Amendment A2:

1. **Thread key inside an authorable app — right.** `ChatDockConversation` derives `editPackageId = appPackageId` exactly when `chatProductOfAgent(activeAgent) === 'build'` and `!isPlatformBuiltinApp({ _packageId: appPackageId })`, and keys `chatConversationScope({ appId: editPackageId, product })`, which is `app:PKG:build`. That is the key `StudioAiCopilot` (`chatConversationScope({ appId: packageId, product })`) and the full page's `?package=` entry already resolve, so the three surfaces share one thread. Matches ruling term 1 and A2 "Key". Reuses `editPackageId` / `chatConversationScope`; no new resolver.
2. **Authorable predicate — right.** The predicate is the A1.b switcher's own `isPlatformBuiltinApp` (the `com.objectstack.` prefix), imported, not re-implemented. Matches A2 "Authorable ... There is no second resolver".
3. **Chip, empty state, agent context — right.** The dock now hands `ChatPane` `editPackageId`. On `main` `ChatPane` already turns that into the chip label (the app matched by `_packageId` in the metadata list), the edit-mode empty state (`Editing "{{app}}"`) and `body.context.packageId`. Matches ruling term 2. Pre-existing fallbacks are unchanged: the chip shows the raw package id and the empty state the generic edit title when the app is not in the list.
4. **Legacy-thread adoption — right.** `legacyScope: editPackageId ? product : undefined` plus `adoptLegacy` through the shared `isThreadBoundToPackage`. The hook runs that read only when nothing is cached under `app:PKG:build`, writes only the new key and leaves the product-only key intact, so the ambient build thread stays reachable in the `/ai` sidebar (ruling term 5) and is adopted only when its own history is bound to PKG (A2 "The product-only thread"). The `AiChatPage` refactor is behaviour-preserving: `Boolean(editPackageId)` became `editPackageId !== undefined`, and the page's `editPackageId` is `searchParams.get('package')?.trim() || undefined`, never an empty string.
5. **Maximize target — right.** `ConsoleLayout.openDockFullPage(boundPackageId?)` navigates a bound thread to `/ai/build?package=PKG` after setting the one-shot `objectstack:ai-full-page-requested` opt-out (the same door `StudioAiCopilot` sets and `AiChatPage`'s built-moment transition consumes), and an unbound thread to `/ai` as before, remembering the return location in both branches. The panel's button now calls `onMaximize(boundPackageId)` explicitly (the previous `onClick={onMaximize}` would have passed the click event as the first argument once the signature widened); the mobile sheet's deferred maximize carries the same value. Studio's `openFullPage` (`() => void`) stays assignable to the widened callback and, with a `children` body, receives `undefined`. Matches ruling term 3 and A2 "Maximize".
6. **Outside an authorable app — unchanged, right.** `ask` yields `editPackageId` undefined and the key `ask` (ambient, no `packageId` in context, no chip); a `com.objectstack.*` app and no app yield the key `build`; bare `/ai/build` is untouched because `AiChatPage`'s `editPackageId` derivation did not change. Matches ruling term 4, card Acceptance 3, and the half of A1.b that A2 keeps.
7. **Scope-matched pane gate — right, beyond the ruling's terms but required.** `scopeMatched = conversationScope === scope` hands the pane `undefined`/empty until the hook re-resolves after an app switch, the same #2450 gate the full page uses; without it a mounted pane would pair the previous app's thread with the new package while the dock stays mounted. Pinned by the app-switch test.
8. **Public surface.** `ChatDockPanelProps` / `ChatDockMobileSheetProps` gain optional `appPackageId` and their `onMaximize` widens to `(boundPackageId?: string) => void`; `isThreadBoundToPackage` becomes a module export of `AiChatPage.tsx`. None of these reach the package entry: `src/index.ts` exports nothing from `layout/ChatDock` (checked `layout/index.ts` too) and re-exports only `AiChatPage`, `DefaultAiChatPage` and `hydratedMessagesToChatMessages` from `AiChatPage.tsx`. `ConsoleLayout` is exported and its props are unchanged. `chatScope.ts` changes documentation only. No locale key moves.
9. **Tests against the card's pin list.** The card asks for pins on the chip text inside an app, the scope key, thread sharing with `/ai/build?package=`, and `ask` staying ambient. `ChatDock.appBinding-10926.test.tsx` carries each of them over the real dock body, `ChatPane`, `useChatConversation` and (for the sharing pin) the real `AiChatPage`, plus the built-in/no-app, adopt/no-adopt, app-switch and both maximize paths; `ConsoleLayout.dockBinding-10926.test.tsx` pins the package hand-off to both presentations and both maximize targets. The test shards on the head are green.

**Changeset prose** (`.changeset/10926-dock-binds-build-thread-to-app.md`), each factual sentence against the diff:

- "binds its build conversation to the app you are in" — true (item 1).
- "Inside an app whose package is not a `com.objectstack.*` platform built-in, a dock whose agent resolves to `build` now keys its conversation `app:PKG:build` — the key the Studio copilot and `/ai/build?package=PKG` already use — so the three show one thread." — true (items 1, 2).
- "The dock's header chip and empty state name the app instead of reading "New app"" — true (item 3).
- "each build request carries the app's package as `context.packageId`" — true (`ChatPane` spreads `packageId: editPackageId` into `body.context`).
- "The dock's "Open full page" button opens `/ai/build?package=PKG` for such a thread." — true; "Open full page" is the `console.ai.dock.maximize` default (item 5).
- "Unchanged: an `ask` dock keeps its app-less thread; inside a `com.objectstack.*` app, or with no current app, a build dock keeps the product-only thread; and bare `/ai/build` still resolves that product-only thread." — true (item 6).
- "The product-only thread is never cleared — it stays listed in the `/ai` sidebar, and a dock entering an app adopts it only when its own history is bound to that app (the same check the `?package=` entry already applies)." — true (item 4).

No sentence overstates the diff. The opt-out on maximize is not mentioned, which is an omission, not an error.

### ② Semver level

`'@object-ui/app-shell': minor`. The diff publishes a new behaviour in the shipped `ConsoleLayout` (the dock binds its build thread; the maximize target follows) with no new entry export, no removal and no rename, so `minor` is the right level for a feature; objectui's fixed-group rule forbids `major` in any case, and the Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Declaration and Changeset Claim Re-read check-runs are green. The claim (`5866972381`, the newest `Claim:` comment; `5868060731` is a file-surface supplement, not a claim) declares `Clause-②: no`, and the PR body repeats `Clause-②: no`: nothing an author can write is removed or narrowed, so no arm and no ADR-0087 marker is owed. Changeset, claim and diff agree.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Claim surface breached by `layout/ConsoleLayout.tsx` and its test** (dev deviation 1). Answered: the claim said stop on breach, the dev instead declared it in the report, and the seat's supplement `5868060731` corrected the surface in the open and measured that no other open PR touches the file. What was touched there is the two `appPackageId` prop lines and `openDockFullPage`; #10924's FAB hunk merged cleanly (merge-base is `origin/main`, PR mergeable state clean). No further action.
2. **The dock runs the A1.b migration read** (dev deviation 2), which the ruling's presented terms do not name. Answered: Amendment A2's decision text records it verbatim ("The dock runs the same A1.b migration read the `?package=` entry runs"), so the code matches the recorded decision as it stands on PR #10947's branch. If that clause changes before #10947 lands, this item needs re-review.
3. **Commit trailers** (dev deviation 3): the five non-merge commits carry `Claude-Session:` and a model-free `Co-authored-by: Claude` line rather than the harness's model-named form. I could not locate the objectui AGENTS.md rule the dev cites by keyword. A commit-message matter with no bearing on the diff; noted for the seat, not weighed.
4. **Zone 2 line reading** (dev deviation 4): confirmed by content, the A1.b clause sits where the claim said; no line citation appears in the ADR text.
5. **`open_questions`**: none filed; nothing to answer.
6. **`sys_metadata` pseudo-package** (dev out-of-scope finding, PR Acceptance note 1). `isPlatformBuiltinApp` is a prefix test and admits `_packageId === 'sys_metadata'`, which `appRoute.ts`'s `studioPackageId` refuses for the Studio bridge; an app list item carrying it would bind the dock to `app:sys_metadata:build`. Against the recorded decision the code is right, because A2 mandates that exact predicate and forbids a second resolver, and the gap is shared with the A1.b switcher already on `main`. Escalated, not decided: it has no carrier. It needs a follow-up card (or a one-line clause in the amendment) to say whether `sys_metadata` is authorable for the build agent; whether any `/meta/app` item carries it is unmeasured. Not blocking.
7. **Thread per app** (PR Acceptance note 2): each authorable app mints its own build thread on first dock open. A2 "Consequences" records exactly this; answered.
8. **Bare `/ai/build` untouched** (PR Acceptance note 3): confirmed by the diff; answered.
9. **Observed, not introduced here:** inside the dock the bound chip is still `ChatPane`'s switcher, so picking another app in its menu navigates the console to `/ai/build?package=Y` and leaves the app page. `main` already mounted that chip in the dock for makers; noted only.
10. **Landing order relative to ADR amendment PR #10947 — flagged, not decided.** The seat intends to hold this code until the amendment merges. (a) Amendment first: `main`'s ADR never forbids a behaviour `main`'s code ships; nothing in this PR cites the amendment textually, so no dependency breaks. (b) Code first: between the two merges the A1.b clause on `main` ("dock/FAB and bare `/ai/build` keep resolving through it") contradicts shipped code. (c) Independently: the amendment reads correctly whichever lands first ("Implemented under objectui#10926"), but this PR's `Fixes #10926` closes the card while the governed half (`Part of #10926`) may still be open. The code carries no technical dependency on #10947; the order is the seat's and the maintainer's call.
